summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of 1,074,022 common shares for $21.6 million in gross proceeds based on March 31, 2026 NAV, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S. The filing also declared routine monthly distributions payable in cash or reinvested under a distribution reinvestment plan. No advisory fees, tender offer, or strategic change is disclosed. This is an ordinary capital raise and distribution declaration, not a special situation.
